title: Pork satay salad
summary: Pork satay salad is a thai dinner built around pork fillet and peanut butter, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook pork fillet for Pork satay salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm lime juice alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss peanut butter with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Pork satay salad straight away. Taste Pork satay salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

image.alt: Pork satay salad served for dinner
